mapper.select:
WITH worker AS ( SELECT Distinct worker_region_id, worker_id, role_code, region_code FROM user_region WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND Nvl(end_date,To_Date('31-DEC-2999')) > sysdate ), query1 AS ( SELECT region_description, Count(distinct s.document_id) pri_open_cnt FROM surveillance_assignment s, coded_region r, nyehms_ehars_stateno_map e , worker u, std_hiv_eclrS_Doc hiv -- ,document_locator doc WHERE s.current_assignment_status IN ('OPEN', 'REOPEN','REASSGN') --and doc.document_id = s.TRIGGERING_DOC_ID -- and doc.document_type_code in ('HIV_LAB', 'PRF')
AND s.current_region_cd = r.region_code AND s.stateno = e.nyehms_stateno(+)
AND s.triggering_doc_id = hiv.document_id(+) AND nvl(hiv.test_result(+), 'x') NOT IN ( 'NEG', 'NO RESULT', 'HIV NEGATIVE', '0' ) AND nvl(hiv.test_result(+), 'x') NOT LIKE '<%'
AND (e.hiv_cdc = 'Y' OR e.aids_cdc = 'Y') AND ((SUBSTR (e.hiv_aids_dx_dt, 1, 4) in (#{previousYear}, #{currentYear})) OR (e.hiv_aids_dx_dt IS NULL)) AND CASE WHEN u.role_code = 1 AND s.current_region_cd = u.region_code THEN 1 WHEN u.role_code = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM worker_assignment w WHERE u.worker_region_id = w.worker_region_id AND w.worker_assignment_id = s.current_worker_assignment_id) THEN 1 WHEN u.role_code = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 GROUP BY region_description ) ,query2 AS ( SELECT region_description, Count(distinct document_id) open_cnt, Sum(CASE WHEN s.CREATE_DATE < TO_DATE('01/01/2025', 'MM/DD/YYYY') and s.CREATE_DATE > SYSDATE - 60 THEN 0 WHEN s.create_date < SYSDATE-#{PRIORITY_ASSIGNMENT_PERIOD} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) cnt_90, Max(fn_to_date(e.hiv_dx_dt,'MMDDYYYY')) hiv_dx_date FROM surveillance_assignment s , coded_region r, nyehms_ehars_stateno_map e , worker u WHERE current_assignment_status IN ('OPEN','REOPEN','REASSGN') AND s.current_region_cd = r.region_code AND s.stateno = e.nyehms_stateno(+) AND CASE WHEN u.role_code = 1 AND s.current_region_cd = u.region_code THEN 1 WHEN u.role_code = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM worker_assignment w WHERE u.worker_region_id = w.worker_region_id AND w.worker_assignment_id = s.current_worker_assignment_id) THEN 1 WHEN u.role_code = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 GROUP BY region_description ) SELECT NVL(a.region_description, b.region_description) region_description, NVL(a.pri_open_cnt, 0) pri_open_cnt, NVL(b.open_cnt, 0) open_cnt, NVL(b.cnt_90, 0) cnt_90 FROM query1 a FULL OUTER JOIN query2 b ON a.region_description = b.region_description
